question: Tell me about a school assignment you worked on.
answer:
One school assignment I worked on was a group presentation for a general course. The topic was something our class could relate to, and our group had to put together a short overview and present it to the class.

My part was mostly helping with the overall organization of the ideas and making sure our presentation flowed in a simple, clear way. I also helped the group stay focused on what we wanted to explain, so we didn’t make it too complicated. Most of the work was done together, and I learned a lot by listening to other people’s ideas and combining them into one presentation.

What I took away from it was that good teamwork really matters, even for a small school assignment. I also learned that keeping things clear and simple can make a big difference when you’re trying to explain something to others.
